title: Chapter 240: Ni Wu, The Commander Of The Army
content:
Chapter 240: Ni Wu, The Commander Of The Army

"Then how does Lord Wang plan to sell this thing?"

"10 energy crystals."

Several people smiled and shook their heads, but did not answer.

"Don't you know that the undead army will be revived next?" Wang Shuo asked in surprise.

"I know, but what does this undead bead have to do with the undead army?"

Wang Shuo smiled in surprise and didn't bother to explain.

"If you don't know what you are good at now, there will always be a time when you come to beg me for help." Wang Shuo sneered in his heart.

"Okay, I'll give you some samples first. After half a month, you can come directly to our territory to pick up the goods." Wang Shuo gave them ten more bronze city bricks.

The reason for the agreement in half a month was that on the one hand, he wanted to use the city wall bricks made during this period, and on the other hand, he wanted to attack Nanshanji.

After discussing the matter, Wang Shuo returned to his room and rested for the night.

The next day, Wang Shuo wanted to visit the mayor of Nanshanji.

In front of the lord's mansion, Wang Shuo asked Zou Yuanjie and the guards to inform him of their intention.

After the guard went in to report, he quickly came out.

"not see."

Wang Shuo looked incredulous, but everything seemed to be expected.

At this moment, Ni Wu walked out of the gate.

After seeing Wang Shuo, his eyes froze.

"Hey, the boy grows up very fast!" Ni Wu said with a wicked smile, "Our Iron Sword Sect is short of a branch station. Your territory is not bad. If you join me, I can give you the position of a hall leader. "

Wang Shuo was shocked and dumbfounded.

This is simply louder than Brunei!

Being underestimated!

"If you join me, I can give you a team leader." Wang Shuo has already exceeded level 30, and the gap in levels is not that big. Moreover, with Gong on his side, Wang Shuo is not shy.

"You are looking for death!" An angry look flashed across his face, and he quickly regained his composure. Then he smiled evilly and turned around to leave.

That expression was like looking at a dead person!

Wang Shuo looked at Ni Wu's back and felt irritated.

He quickly sent a message to Guan Jie, the undercover agent of Iron Sword Sect.

"Has the Iron Sword Sect done anything big recently?"

Soon, Guan Jie replied: "Returning to the lord, there is no such thing! It's just that Ni Wu served as the commander of the Dianjun in Nanshanji, and can command 100 soldiers in Nanshanji."

Wang Shuo was silent in thought, and after a while, he told Guan Jie to continue to pay close attention to the movements of the entire Iron Sword Sect.

At this time, Wang Shuo noticed that a friend sent him a message.

"Brother Wang, have you noticed? The system towns have begun to collect taxes from our villages?"

This message from Zhang Yang made Wang Shuo stunned.

Collect taxes?

"Have you handed it over?" Wang Shuo frowned, a little confused.

"Hand it in! My heart is bleeding. It's 100 gold coins per person."

"I'm going to steal the money! Are you going to take this advantage?"

"Isn't there nothing I can do? The other side has sent an elite force and will attack the village if they don't surrender. How can I defend it?"

When Wang Shuo heard this, he had an ominous premonition in his heart.

Could it be that Ni Wu is planning to make a fuss about this matter?

"I haven't received any news yet, I wish you good luck!"

After saying that, Wang Shuo thought for a moment and must rush back as soon as possible to prevent something unexpected.

Halfway through, Guan Jie sent another message.

"Lord, Ni Wu led the main force of Iron Sword Sect and 100 Nanshan guards to head towards Wana Village."

Sure enough, this kid has no good intentions.

After returning to his territory, Wang Shuo hurried to the ancient battlefield and recalled Ayub.

At the same time, the order was ordered to prepare to meet the invading enemy.

As for paying the head tax, it was just an excuse for the other party. Ni Wu's trip must be to occupy his own village.

Not long after, Ni Wu led his people to Wana Village.
